title: ProgramOverlay
description: Per-locale editorial prose for a program, at i18n-src/{locale}/programs/{id}.json. Per PRD-029. The editorial spine — the_land → goals → outcome → narrative — is authored en-US first; the 14-locale pass runs after the form locks. Each spine section is an ordered list of blocks so images embed INSIDE the editorial (magazine-style), not just a hero.

tagline.description: One-line hook, shown on the index card + hero (the best_known_for).

the_land.description: Where the world + technology stood; why the program existed. Neutral, honest.

goals.description: What the agency set out to do — objectives + hoped-for outcomes.

outcome.description: What came of it — met, missed, cancelled, open. Stated, not graded.

narrative.description: The editorial story tying the roster together.

legacy.description: What it gave back — impact on humanity + specific nations: economy, spinoffs, science, soft power, inspiration. Advocacy voice, still sourced + neutral.

lessons.description: What we can learn — the leadership / team-playbook / human-inspiration takeaway. A transferable lesson on doing hard things (a good story, a piece of trivia, the 'how to be better' element), grounded in the program, not preachy.

body.description: Ordered blocks: prose paragraphs interleaved with embedded figures.

md.description: One paragraph. Light markdown (emphasis, links) allowed.

image.description: Either reuse an existing gallery image (provenance inherited) or a program-owned editorial image sourced via the pipeline (PRD-018) + approved at /dev/staging.

reuse.description: Ref to an existing image, e.g. 'missions/apollo-11/03' or 'fleet/saturn-v/01'.

id.description: Program-owned image id under static/images/programs/{program}/{id}, e.g. 'the-land/sputnik'.

credit.description: Attribution line; for reused images the provenance manifest is authoritative and this may be omitted.
